press_references.value: Wiliot Collaborates with Walmart to Transform Retail Supply Chain with Ambient IoT and AI

partnership_announcements.description: Wiliot announced a collaboration with Walmart to deploy millions of ambient IoT "IoT Pixels" across Walmart’s supply chain, integrating data with Walmart’s AI to boost efficiency, inventory accuracy, and cold chain compliance. The rollout is active at 500 locations, with a national expansion planned in 2026 covering 4,600 stores and 40+ distribution centers, and a goal to track 90 million pallets by end-2026.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The company develops systems such as a System and method for determining the localization of an object, Tag location method and apparatus, Wireless tag location, and Determining collective location of low energy wireless tags to track items with low energy wireless tags. Titles like Light sensing low energy wireless tag, Wireless sampler transmitter, Wireless tag calibration, and Single layer LC oscillator show work on self powered sensing. Configurable harvester and Method for operating a network of ambient IoT devices address RF energy harvesting and ambient IoT networking. Together these indicate R and D in tag sensing, localization, calibration, power management, and networking.

overview_description.description: Wiliot is bringing connectivity and intelligence to everyday products and packaging; things previously disconnect from the Internet of Things. The Wiliot Platform combines cloud services and IoT stickers, computing elements that can power themselves by harvesting radiofrequency energy. This revolutionary mixture of cloud and semiconductor technology is being used by some of the world’s largest brands, food, and pharmaceutical companies to change how we make, distribute, sell, use and recycle products.

about_short_description.short_description: Wiliot is an IoT company that develops self-powered tags that can be attached to products and packaging to sense a range of data.

product.name: Wiliot IoT Pixels
product.description: Battery-free Bluetooth sensors that attach to products, packaging, and assets to capture data such as location, temperature, humidity, and light using energy harvested from ambient radio signals.

product.name: Wiliot Physical AI Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that converts continuous IoT Pixel data into supply chain intelligence through AI and machine-learning models, alerts, analytics, dashboards, and operational insights.

product.name: Wiliot Network Infrastructure
product.description: A connectivity layer using bridges and gateways to energize nearby IoT Pixels, receive their sensor data, and securely forward it to the Wiliot Physical AI Platform.

product.name: Inventory Intelligence
product.description: A scan-free inventory visibility service that continuously tracks item presence and movement to improve inventory accuracy, availability, and supply chain decisions.

product.name: Automated Receiving
product.description: An AI-enabled receiving service that uses continuous, scan-free item data to automate receipt confirmation and reduce manual processing at warehouses and facilities.

product.name: Reusable Asset Tracking
product.description: A scan-free service for monitoring reusable transport packaging and other assets, helping organizations locate items, reduce shrink, and improve fleet utilization.
